observations: Blue painted industrial gear reducer with a cast iron body.
A yellow hexagonal output shaft is visible.
A mounting flange is attached to the side of the housing.
The unit is mounted on a blue cast iron base plate.
No brand name, model number, or technical specifications are visible on the exterior in any photo.
Watermark 'IFABROS INDUSTRIAL POSTED ON JIJI' appears on all photos.

claims.evidence: No rating plate or nameplate is visible in the photos.
The casting texture and flange design in photo 0 and photo 1 are consistent with cast iron construction.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The internal gear meshing and bearings may be damaged or worn.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running under load or a clear photo of the internal gears.

risks.risk: The output shaft may be damaged or have a different diameter than claimed.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the output shaft and a photo of the shaft keyway.

risks.risk: The input shaft may be damaged or have a different diameter.
risks.proof: A photo of the input shaft.

risks.risk: The actual horsepower rating may be significantly lower than the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's nameplate.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's nameplate showing the model number and horsepower rating.
Video of the unit in operation.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
